description: Kennedy breaking (A 550 3) on the multi-block grid of nhflow_3d_mb_breaking (the bore of a dam break with its step at the interface of blocks 0 and 2): the parts of nhflow_breaking::kennedy_part run over all level-0 grids with exchanges of the ages, the band passes and the flags between them (nhflow_amr::kennedy_level0); one block to 1e-14 m after 0.2 s (validation/11_block_kennedy_filter).
